name: Mito Kakusuke
source:
A delinquent from Ibaraki, he leads Inokashira's strongest delinquent team "Benten" and is busy taking control of the city center. He was thinking of bringing Shonan under his control as well, but when he went to scout the area, he became worried after learning of Ai and her friends' presence.
He is considered the strongest in Ibaraki and Chiba, and is also said to be the strongest professional brawler in Kanto. He is also good at communication.
He has poor fashion sense, which is often teased by Hiroshi and his Benten friends.
